items.why: 16.67% chance to dodge an attack when hit, which grants +10% crit and summon damage for 4s; taking damage also has a 60% chance to confuse nearby enemies.

items.name: Star Veil
items.why: Doubles the length of the player's immunity frames (to 4/3 of a second), and summons falling stars when the player is hit.

items.name: Frozen Shield
items.why: Essentially an upgraded version of the Frozen Turtle Shell which provides 6 defense, reduces all damage taken by the player by 25% if the player is below 50% max HP, and grants immunity to knockback.

items.name: Moon Stone
items.source: Dropped by Vampires during a Solar Eclipse
items.why: In respect to survivability, the Moon Stone increases the player's defense by 4 and health regeneration by 1 HP/s, from 7:30 PM to 4:30 AM.

items.name: Hero Shield
items.why: Provides 10 defense, increases the player's aggro by 400, and provides immunity to knockback.
items.notes: Players seeking to use defensive setups that use the Hero Shield, Flesh Knuckles, and Berserker's Glove simultaneously will need a total of three Flesh Knuckles (or Putrid Scents to shimmer into them). Strongly consider making a place to farm enemies for Souls of Night, as obtaining all three will no doubt be tedious.

items.name: Flesh Knuckles

Strongly consider making a place to farm enemies for Souls of Night, as obtaining all three will no doubt be tedious.

items.name: Master Ninja Gear

items.why: Increases magic damage by 15%.

items.name: Mana Cloak
items.why: Combines the effects of the Mana Flower and Star Cloak. Additionally, the stars produced by the Star Cloak will transform into special mana stars, which restore 50 mana to the player.

items.effect: 8% reduced mana cost · Automatically use mana potions when needed

weapons.name: Xeno Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by the Martian Saucer during Martian Madness
weapons.why: Summons UFO minions with instantaneous non-missing attacks; event is post-Golem.

weapons.name: Ballista Staff
weapons.source: Bought from the Tavernkeep after defeating Golem (tier 3)
weapons.why: Tier 3 Tavernkeep upgrade of the ballista bolt sentry.

weapons.name: Explosive Trap Staff
weapons.source: Bought from the Tavernkeep after defeating Golem (tier 3)
weapons.why: Tier 3 Tavernkeep upgrade of the explosive trap sentry.

weapons.name: Flameburst Staff
weapons.source: Bought from the Tavernkeep after defeating Golem (tier 3)
weapons.why: Tier 3 Tavernkeep upgrade of the flameburst fireball sentry.

weapons.name: Lightning Aura Staff
weapons.source: Bought from the Tavernkeep after defeating Golem (tier 3)
weapons.why: Tier 3 Tavernkeep upgrade of the lightning aura sentry.

weapons.name: Tempest Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by Duke Fishron (summonable any time in Hardmode)
weapons.why: Summons Sharknado minions; Duke Fishron requires only Hardmode, no mechanical boss.

weapons.name: Raven Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by the Pumpking during the Pumpkin Moon
weapons.why: Summons Raven minions; obtained from the post-Plantera Pumpkin Moon event.

weapons.name: Staff of the Frost Hydra
weapons.source: Found in the Dungeon's Ice Chest, opened with a Frozen Key (post-Plantera)
weapons.why: Post-Plantera sentry summoning a Frost Hydra that fires piercing frost blasts.

weapons.name: Morning Star
weapons.source: Dropped by Armored Bones enemies in the post-Plantera Hardmode Dungeon
weapons.why: Dropped by Hardmode Dungeon Armored Bones and gains crit chance with combos.

weapons.name: Electric Eel
weapons.source: Dropped by Duke Fishron (summonable in Hardmode, no boss prerequisite)
weapons.why: Duke Fishron drop with long range that chains lightning between enemies.

weapons.name: Blade Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by Queen Slime
weapons.why: Summons Enchanted Dagger minions with low base damage that ignore 25 defense, scaling on flat/tag bonuses.

weapons.name: Kaleidoscope
weapons.source: Dropped by the Empress of Light (summoned after Plantera)
weapons.why: Empress of Light drop giving one of the largest summon tag damage bonuses.

weapons.name: Terraprisma
weapons.source: Dropped by the Empress of Light if all damage is dealt during the day
weapons.why: Summons homing sword minions; Empress is fought via a post-Plantera Prismatic Lacewing. Only drops if the Empress of Light is killed in daylight, where every one of her attacks is an instant kill.

weapons.name: Dark Harvest
weapons.source: Dropped by Pumpking during the Pumpkin Moon
weapons.why: Pumpking drop whose swings can hit multiple times with a strong summon tag.

weapons.name: Deadly Sphere Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by Deadly Spheres during a Solar Eclipse
weapons.why: Summons orbiting Deadly Sphere minions that dash at enemies.

armor.name: Spooky Armor

armor.why: 24 defense, 30% summon damage and greatly increased life regeneration.

accessories.name: Master Ninja Gear

accessories.name: Terraspark Boots

accessories.name: Fishron Wings
accessories.why: Flight, and faster movement in rain and water.

buffs.name: Bewitching Table
buffs.source: Placed station buff from the Dungeon
buffs.why: It stacks perfectly with your potion setup and should always be active for real attempts.

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Summoner still wants every baseline survivability layer it can reasonably get.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

buffs.name: Flask of Venom

buffs.name: War Table
buffs.source: Dropped by the Dark Mage and Ogre during the Old One's Army
buffs.why: Table buff that boosts minion damage.
